current_bar.hunt: Hunt a selector on BTC that enters only when a 2–3% move is more likely than the stop — enough that the book is green after the 0.31% round-trip fee.
rules: BOTH long and short must have net expR > 0 after 0.31% RT.
Each side must sit above the unconditional census base for this shell (~−0.211 long / ~−0.234 short at 4h, H=24, M=3, S=1.5).
A book that is only less negative than −0.211 / −0.234 fails.
A positive long or short slice does not save a negative both-sides book.
No side-cut to save a thin green slice. Do not drop M. Do not widen S.
Thin n is a note, not an automatic fail, and it is not a pass.
current_bar.scale: If every miss is a full stop, net expR > 0 needs a target share above (S+0.31)/(M+S) = 1.81/4.5 = 40.2%. Unconditional target-first at the base cell is 21.34% long and 21.22% short, about 1.9× the base rate, not a filter tweak. Timeouts can make a lower share still fail or, if they pay, clear with less. The share is the scale of the lift. The binding test is the net.
current_bar.capture: Unconditional free-bar captures of 2–3% exist (~1-in-3 for 2%, ~1-in-5 for 3% inside 24h on 4h) but are net negative after fees (~−0.21R on the headline 3%/1.5% cells). Leverage does not fix negative expectancy.

paths.name: Shell retune — wider stop, smaller target, longer hold
paths.note: Cannot clear 0.31% RT on free bars. Not a capitalize path.
paths.detail: The least-bad cell is already the wide stop (S=5) and it is still net-negative. Best net in the grid is −0.0531. Holding the best observed gross (+0.0089) fixed, the haircut 0.31/S drops below that gross only if S is larger than 0.31/0.0089, about 35%. That is not a trading shell, and a wider stop would not keep that gross. No shell retune is pre-registered.
